title: Librería de Satoshi Rebrands to ISMOS, Launches Global Platform to Train One Million Bitcoin Developers
summary: Bitcoin Magazine Librería de Satoshi Rebrands to ISMOS, Launches Global Platform to Train One Million Bitcoin Developers Dulce Villarreal’s ISMOS rebrands from Latin America’s Librería de Satoshi and launches a multilingual open-source platform to train one million Bitcoin and Freedom Tech developers worldwide, backed by Btrust and the Human Rights Foundation. This post Librería de Satoshi Rebrands to ISMOS, Launches Global Platform to Train One Million Bitcoin Developers first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Juan Galt .
